### About

Yashada Enterprises has been a trusted name in industrial supply since 2005. We:
1. **Manufacture** self-adhesive tapes in-house (surface protection, double-sided, foam gasket, anti-skid, security void, PVC insulation, etc.)
2. **Distribute** premium industrial electrical components from 4+ authorized brands
3. Serve **panel builders, OEMs, and electrical contractors** across Maharashtra and India

---

## Authorized Brands

### Steelgrip
Premium PVC electrical insulation tapes with excellent dielectric strength and moisture resistance. Used for cable harnessing, colour coding, and electrical safety.

### Abro
Masking, packaging, and adhesive tapes for carpentry, powder coating, painting, and surface protection. Known for quality crepe paper masking tape.

### Woer
Heat-shrinkable tubing and sleeves for electrical insulation, strain relief, and environmental protection of wire connections. Available in various diameters.

### Surelock
Nylon cable ties (nylon 6.6) for secure wire bundling and cable management in industrial and domestic installations.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Where is Yashada Enterprises located?**  
A: We are located at Shop No. 11 & 12, Shree Sai Industrial Estate, Ambad, Nashik, Maharashtra 422010, India.

**Q: Do you supply outside Nashik?**  
A: Yes, we supply industrial tapes and electrical components to customers across Maharashtra and India. Contact us for bulk orders and shipping details.

**Q: Can I get a quote for bulk orders?**  
A: Yes. Contact us via WhatsApp (+91 82089 97234) or the contact form on our website.

**Q: Are you an authorized distributor?**  
A: Yes. We are authorized distributors for Steelgrip, Abro, Woer, and Surelock brands.

**Q: Do you manufacture any products?**  
A: Yes. We manufacture self-adhesive tapes in-house, including surface protection tape, double-sided tape, foam gasket tape, anti-skid tape, security void tape, and PVC insulation tape.
